memo_delta.stage_one_comment: The original 2026-08-31 NU call remains Avoid, with no long or short position. As of the October 6 close, the stock is above the frozen US$14.30 anchor, so the no-position decision has a foregone gain. That price result has not settled the investment thesis. Both recorded Q3 miss forecasts are still open in their November 5–20 window, and the Group required-return assumption remains unresolved. The October first-round election was reported alongside buying in Brazilian assets; this does not prove better loan performance or durable returns. Management also denied pursuing Monzo on September 30. Keep the frozen valuation and its positive tail visible, preserve the credit and bank-prudential gaps, and obtain the Q3 standalone filing before revisiting the decision. Review-time confidence is not assessable.
